headline: After Claiming ‘Bias’ at Smithsonian, Trump Officials Stage Patriotic Exhibition
context: Trump officials have promised to “make visual arts great,” with a museum exhibition that includes artwork by several people with personal connections to the planners.

sources.name: The New York Times
